1-about-this-publication: This online edition is the official one. Past years are in the archived eCalendars and Course Catalogues.
McGill may change anything here without notice, including fixing errors and altering fees, admission schedules and credit requirements, or revising and cancelling courses and programs.
Senate has the final say on what academic regulations mean.

You are responsible for knowing McGill's procedures, policies and regulations and your program's requirements, and registering means you agree to follow them. Advice is there when you ask, but choosing the right courses to graduate is up to you.
Not every course runs every year. Check the Minerva Class Schedule for what is offered.
The publication year runs from the start of Fall to the end of Summer. If you start at any point in it, you follow the edition that took effect that Fall.

McGill isn't responsible for providing courses, programs, housing or other services when events such as utility failures, fire, flood, strikes, labour disputes, war, insurrection or the law reasonably prevent it.
Throughout, "you" means students newly admitted, readmitted or returning to McGill.
